sections.title: Valuation Insights
sections.text: Visa posts a high operating margin of [[V.ratio.operating_margin]] and a strong return on average equity of [[V.ratio.return_on_average_equity]]. Debt‑to‑equity stands at [[V.ratio.debt_to_equity]], indicating moderate leverage. Free cash flow of [[V.ratio.free_cash_flow]] underpins share repurchases and dividend growth. The annual price‑earnings multiple of [[V.ratio.price_earnings]] reflects market expectations relative to earnings. Revenue grew by [[V.ratio.revenue_growth]] year over year, supporting the top‑line momentum.

insight.text: Leverage remains moderate, as indicated by the debt‑to‑equity ratio.
